extDescription.message: Opens PDFs in a full PDF viewer and editor (PdfCraft): light, local, no cloud. A drop-in replacement for Acrobat Reader.

popTagline.message: Read, organize, sign and protect PDFs

popAutoHint.message: In the browser, instead of Chrome's viewer

popOpenLocal.message: Open a PDF from this computer…

popNative.message: Open this PDF in Chrome's viewer

popFileAccess.message: Turn on “Allow access to file URLs” to open local and downloaded PDFs.

badgeTitle.message: Open this PDF in a new tab with PdfCraft

errFile.message: For local files, turn on “Allow access to file URLs” in the extension settings:

errFileCopy.message: (copy and paste the address into a new tab)

errServer.message: The server did not return the file ($ERR$).

errWebgl.message: WebGL2 is required: make sure hardware acceleration is on in chrome://settings/system.
